author: Turkey Tom
description:
Over the last 2 decades, Shia LaBeouf has caused enough controversy to end his career 10 times over. At first it seemed he was simply a troubled young actor, getting into bar fights and being arrested for petty crimes - not ideal, but as a young man, he had time to sort it out. However as fame failed to fix the darkness from his childhood, Shia began to act bizarrely. He had freakouts on social media, pulled strange stunts, and ingratiated himself in meme culture. Some laughed at things like 'I'm not famous anymore' and 'He Will Not Divide Us' while others expressed concern. While he momentarily got his act together for some major roles, unfortunately Shia's addiction continued to plague his life. In the most disturbing twists yet, not only had he admitted to abusing one of his girlfriends, but he also admits he exaggerated much of the hardship his father supposedley put him through. This is the story of how Hollywood broke Shia Labeouf. 

Thanks for watching :)
